name: ResQme
tagline: A mesh network of small radio devices that keeps people messaging when cell towers and internet fail.
problem: Communication fails first in disaster zones.
solution: ESP32 nodes relay messages through each other on a mesh; a master node hosts a Wi-Fi page for messages and status, with GPS and small screens for field use and optional cloud mirroring.
demo_moment: Team-described: send a message across several nodes with no internet.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “2nd Best Overall Hack” among 160 submissions.

lessons: Unplug the internet on stage to prove an offline claim.
